summary: Iteration 4: tested Tümünü düzelt (API+UI), the Yenilikler dialog (API+UI) and light regression. All requested features work. The new API e2e file passed 9/9: a candidate with 2 separate same-section violations (4 affected students) gave 201 with fix_summary {moved:2, affected_before:4, affected_after:0}. The new 'manual' child is selected and persisted, the parent is not mutated, there are no duplicate seats and the assignment count is preserved. A non-selected candidate gets 409 'Önce bu adayı incelemeye alın.', a candidate without violations gets 409 'Bu adayda düzeltilecek komşuluk ihlali yok.' and an unknown candidate gets 404. whats-new returns show:true with notes [0.2.0] when last_seen is 0.1.0. POST seen writes 0.2.0 and the next GET returns show:false. A fresh install (key missing) writes the current version, keeps the other keys and returns show:false. A corrupt file gives 200 with show:false. Regression: backend unit 29/29 and previous e2e files 25/25. In the UI, the red 'Tümünü düzelt' button (rgb 217,71,59) appears only on the selected candidate and is hidden on non-selected ones. Clicking it created 'Aday 4 · Manuel sürüm' with 0 violations, auto-selected, and the notice read '2 öğrenci taşındı · ihlalden etkilenen öğrenci 4 → 0.'. The Yenilikler modal 'Sürüm 0.2.0 ile gelenler' lists 5 items, closes, and does not reappear on reload. 'Taşı ve düzelt' still works, focus/neighbour highlight is 1/1, the progress overlay appears on candidate create, and the update card shows the no-key message with the file picker and inspect button hidden. scripts/release.py --help works; the build was not run here.

issues: The fix summary [data-testid=exam-notice] renders at the top of the exam list. After clicking 'Tümünü düzelt' on a candidate further down, the notice was about 2400px above the viewport (bbox y=-2416, scrollY=2754), so the user does not see the 'N öğrenci taşındı · X → Y' result. Show it inline in or near the new candidate card, use a fixed toast, or scroll the notice into view.
There is no Escape-key or backdrop-click close; only the button closes it. This is minor and acceptable for a one-time modal.

action_items: Make the 'Tümünü düzelt' result notice visible where the user clicked (inline in the candidate card, a toast, or scrollIntoView).
critical_code_review_comments: fix_candidate_violations: the ValueError when nothing could be moved is raised inside session_factory.begin(), so the draft child candidate is rolled back correctly and the endpoint returns 409.

fix_candidate_violations: organizations whose status is neither draft nor completed get the misleading message 'Önce bu adayı incelemeye alın.' even when the candidate is selected. A status-specific message would be clearer.

The greedy loop re-runs _review_selected_candidate after every move. Each review rebuilds the neighbour graph, so cost is O(moves × review), which is fine at school scale. The attempts cap is len(suggestions)*2+2.

get_whats_new is a GET that writes to disk when the key is missing (fresh install). This is acceptable but has a side effect; _ui_state_path's parent directory must exist on first run, otherwise write_text raises OSError, which is not caught on the write path. Verify that the data dir is always created before this call.
WhatsNewDialog sets the notes even if the POST /seen fails, so the modal would reappear next launch. This is acceptable behaviour.
File sizes: ExamOrganizer.tsx (816 lines) and exam_organizations.py (1103 lines) keep growing past the 700-line guideline.
seed_data_creation: Created draft orgs TEST_FIX_* (1 via pytest) and TEST_FIXUI_* (e6e9574c-…, 33cbb92a-…, 90eee88b-…) with candidates. There is no org delete endpoint, so they are left in place. Seed data was not modified. ui_state.json was left at {"last_seen_version": "0.2.0"}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: KELEBEK_PUBLIC_URL=$preview_endpoint /root/.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/e2e/test_fix_all_whats_new_e2e.py -p no:cacheprovider -v. This creates 1 TEST_FIX org and temporarily rewrites ui_state.json, restoring it to 0.2.0. UI prep: python tests/e2e/prep_ui_fix_all.py <N> creates a TEST_FIXUI org with a selected candidate that has N violations and prints the org and candidate ids. For the whats-new UI, write {"last_seen_version":"0.1.0"} to /root/.local/share/kelebek-sinav-sistemi/ui_state.json, then load the app.
